capabilities: Browse PARA folders as a sidebar note tree
Create notes and folders inline with folder-note hierarchy
Convert leaf notes into folder notes with link updates
Show folder statistics such as note counts and open tasks
extras: The plugin was awaiting community review at the time of the README ("Once approved, install from Obsidian's community plugin list"); the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer does not present a PARA folder structure as a navigable note tree with per-folder dashboards and statistics.
summary: PARA-method sidebar navigator that shows the Inbox/Projects/Areas/Resources/Archives tree as folder notes, with per-folder Bases tables and statistics dashboards.
